key_insight: KaiNinja extends a native 3D generator from whole-object meshes to part-level assets by replacing the single O-Voxel volume with a dual-volume representation that can model part interfaces.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster part-aware generation for downstream editing, rigging, and simulation without relying on an external segmentation step.
method: Builds on TRELLIS.2’s native 3D generation backbone
Introduces a dual-volume form of O-Voxel to represent touching parts
Trains on mixed part-data sources, including CAD and LLM-agent-authored assets
evidence_signal: The paper reports improved whole-object and part-level performance, including 40% lower Chamfer distance and 16% higher strict part F-score versus other part generation pipelines.
watch_item: Performance and robustness likely depend on the availability and quality of part-labeled training data, especially for complex interfaces between touching parts.
paper_title: Kaininja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
